data.name: Jeb
data.gender_notes: Jeb is used as a male name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The meaning of Jeb is recorded in name-lists as “God is great”. This meaning has NOT been verified against a classical lexical or onomastic source, so it is published as an unverified candidate only. The record is flagged for manual source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: Jeb expresses “God is great”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jeb total 8, reducing to 8. Number 8 is associated with ambition, authority and material mastery.

in_hebrew.name: Jeb
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו God is great
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Jeb הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. From the Hebrew yeb, meaning 'God is great'. In the Hebrew Bible, Jeb is the name of several individuals, including a son of Issachar and an idolatrous king of the Ammonites.

in_greek.name: Jeb
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει God is great
in_greek.long_meaning: Jeb είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. From the Hebrew yeb, meaning 'God is great'. In the Hebrew Bible, Jeb is the name of several individuals, including a son of Issachar and an idolatrous king of the Ammonites.

in_latin.name: Jeb
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat God is great
in_latin.long_meaning: Jeb est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. From the Hebrew yeb, meaning 'God is great'. In the Hebrew Bible, Jeb is the name of several individuals, including a son of Issachar and an idolatrous king of the Ammonites.
